sources.title: Introduction to Business Administration
sources.date_version: 2022 LOUIS adaptation; current licence presentation checked 2026-09-27
sources.educational_role: Broad reusable Business truth across enterprise, management, people, operations, marketing, accounting, finance, global business and project scheduling/CPM.
sources.restrictions: Licence applies except where otherwise noted. Exclude separately attributed third-party images, videos, embeds and other media; use independently authored Revision prose.

sources.title: Microeconomics
sources.date_version: 2024 LOUIS edition; current licence presentation checked 2026-09-27
sources.educational_role: Reusable economic mechanisms relevant to Business: demand, PED/YED, pricing/revenue, market structure, trade and tariffs.
sources.restrictions: Licence applies except where otherwise noted. Exclude separately attributed media/items; bound use to Level 3 Business rather than teaching a full economics course.

sources.title: Foundations in Digital Marketing
sources.educational_role: Reusable marketing truth for segmentation, targeting, positioning, customer journeys, digital channels and customer strategy.
sources.restrictions: Exclude third-party videos, stock/media items and any component carrying a different licence; use author-created CC BY text/diagrams only.

sources.issuer: Roger H. Hermanson, James D. Edwards and Michael W. Maher / BCcampus
sources.title: Accounting Principles: A Business Perspective
sources.date_version: Copyright 2011; CC BY / Attribution 3.0 edition metadata checked 2026-09-27
sources.educational_role: Reusable accounting and managerial-finance truth for costs, CVP/break-even, budgets, financial statements, ratios and interpretation.
sources.restrictions: Use textbook-authored material only; exclude separately credited third-party material. Course-specific UK formula conventions still require exact-course mapping.

sources.title: Strategic Analysis - Understanding a Firm’s Competitive Environment
sources.date_version: Last modified 2024-08-06; current CC BY 4.0 page metadata checked 2026-09-27
sources.educational_role: Reusable strategic-analysis framing for SWOT, PESTEL, Five Forces, internal environment and competitive advantage.
sources.restrictions: Use only the page/chapter content carrying CC BY 4.0; exclude separately attributed third-party media or differently licensed material.

sources.issuer: Richard Puyt, Peter H. Antoniou and Andrea Caputo
sources.title: The Ansoff archive: Revisiting Ansoff's legacy and the holistic approach to strategic management
sources.educational_role: Reusable provenance and educational framing for Ansoff's product-market growth framework as a model rather than universal factual law.
sources.restrictions: Use for framework provenance/context, not as proof that its risk ordering is deterministic or universally valid.

sources.issuer: Vagner Marcondes Corrêa and Gilmerson Inácio Gonçalves / Revista Interface Tecnológica
sources.title: Change Management in the COVID-19 Pandemic Scenario: using the Kurt Lewin model
sources.educational_role: Reusable framework provenance and application context for Lewin's change model.
sources.restrictions: Use as model provenance/context rather than universal predictive truth; Revision teaching remains independently authored and bounded to Level 3.

sources.title: Set up a business / business structure guidance
sources.educational_role: UK legal-form and ownership/liability factual basis.
sources.restrictions: Subject to page-specific exceptions and third-party rights; legal/tax details are time-sensitive.

sources.title: Companies Act 2006 section 172
sources.date_version: Companies Act 2006 section 172; current legislation presentation checked 2026-09-27
sources.educational_role: Directors' duty / stakeholder and long-term considerations.
sources.restrictions: Legislation can be amended; legal application is contextual. Do not imply legal advice.

sources.title: Labour productivity quality and methodology information
sources.educational_role: Productivity definitions, measurement and interpretation.
sources.restrictions: Exclude third-party photographs, illustrations, video and separately licensed material; methodology exceeds Level 3 depth in places.

sources.title: Management practices in the UK
sources.educational_role: Management practices, targets, people practices and evidence-quality context.
sources.restrictions: Exclude third-party material; observational associations do not by themselves establish causal business rules.

sources.title: The Green Book 2026
sources.educational_role: Decision appraisal, alternatives, uncertainty, risk, sensitivity and option comparison.
sources.restrictions: Government appraisal depth exceeds Level 3 Business; use only transferable decision principles and exclude third-party material.

sources.title: The State of UK Competition Report 2024
sources.educational_role: Competition, market power and market-functioning factual/evidence basis.
sources.restrictions: Current market conditions can change; exclude third-party data/material with separate rights.

sources.title: Dynamic pricing: tips for businesses
sources.educational_role: Pricing transparency, consumer-protection and dynamic-pricing context.
sources.restrictions: Guidance can change; use for factual/legal context rather than as a complete pricing theory.

sources.title: Net Zero business sector roadmap guidelines
sources.educational_role: Business decarbonisation, transition and net-zero context.
sources.restrictions: Policy and technical standards evolve; exclude separately licensed third-party content.

sources.title: Green claims and your business
sources.educational_role: Environmental claims, evidence boundaries and consumer-protection context.
sources.restrictions: Guidance and enforcement context can change; do not treat it as the whole of sustainability or ESG.

sources.title: Seasonal adjustment
sources.educational_role: Trend, seasonality, irregular movement and moving-average concepts.
sources.restrictions: Exclude third-party items; official-statistics method depth exceeds Level 3 Business.

sources.title: Uncertainty and how we measure it for our surveys
sources.educational_role: Sampling uncertainty, confidence intervals, standard error and sampling/non-sampling error.
sources.restrictions: Exclude third-party items; advanced inferential-statistics calculation remains outside general Business foundation.

sources.title: Methodology topics and statistical concepts
sources.educational_role: Index numbers, sampling, estimation, data quality and statistical interpretation.
sources.restrictions: Gateway to methods rather than a single exhaustive teaching source; exclude third-party items.

sources.issuer: Gelmar García Vidal et al. / Cogent Business & Management
sources.title: Contribution margin and quantity matrix to analyze the product portfolio in the context of SMEs: criticism of the BCG matrix and its alternatives
sources.date_version: Published 2023; CC BY 4.0 open-access article licence checked 2026-09-27
sources.educational_role: Reusable description and critical treatment of the BCG growth-share matrix and portfolio-analysis assumptions.
sources.restrictions: Use as framework description/critique rather than treating BCG categories or prescriptions as universal factual laws.
